letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every gentle breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Your smile lights up my world like the desert sun, and your laugh is the sweetest monsoon melody. I cherish our endless chats, our late‑night walks, and the way you call me “cutie” when I’m being silly. No matter where we are, my heart beats only for you, today and always.
poem:
Across two cities, love finds its rhyme,  
Your hand in mine, defying time.  
In desert heat or monsoon’s kiss,  
Forever yours, my endless bliss.
